about: A second LLM smoke slice (CI, on merge to main and nightly), only for ordinary work-permit salary questions: two plain wordings in English and Swedish must be answered for the ordinary work permit, not asked back ("which work permit?"). The first wording got a question back in five of six answers on the live site before rule 5 of the answer prompt said that "a work permit" means the ordinary one. No failure is allowed (a failing question is asked a second time before it counts): without the rule the behaviour flips from hour to hour, and with the earlier prompt the question failed in only one run of three, so this is a sensitive but weak guard, not proof. Chosen 2026-11-26; its flakiness is to be judged over the nightly runs. Run with: permitnav smoke --file evals/golden.kinds.jsonl --smoke evals/smoke.kinds.json --queries evals/queries.kinds.json.
